text:
sam: hey team, first day — stuck on onboarding network. On a company MacBook M2, connected to home Wi‑Fi and the WireGuard profile from Okta. I can reach the internet but none of the 10.x internal services (git.internal, dashboard) respond. i can ssh to bastion.corp.redwood.com but trying to proxy through it times out. any quick checks?

marta: welcome! quick checks — can you paste the output of `netstat -nr | head -n 20` and `wg show`? also check `scutil --dns` to see if corporate DNS is pushed. split‑tunnel usually drops internal 10./16 routes if the profile tag wasn't applied.

sam: netstat shows default via 192.168.1.1 and no 10. routes. `wg show` looks like the tunnel is up, peer listed. scutil shows only my ISP DNS.

marta: sounds like split‑tunnel didn't add the internal routes. temporary workaround: if you can SSH to the bastion, start a dynamic SOCKS proxy and use that for git/browser. e.g.:
```
ssh -D 1080 -N -p 443 sam@bastion.corp.redwood.com
```
Then point your browser to socks5://localhost:1080 or run git through the proxy.

alex: for git over socks, one quick way: `export GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -o ProxyCommand='nc -x localhost:1080 %h %p'"` then run `git clone git@internal:repo.git`. Or add a per‑host ssh config: `~/.ssh/config` snippet: 
```
Host *.internal
  ProxyCommand nc -X 5 -x localhost:1080 %h %p
```
That avoids messing with system routes while IT fixes your profile.

marta: also FYI we have an alternate bastion that listens on 443 for home ISPs that block 22 — use `-p 443` like in alex's example. If that still fails open a ticket and include your public IP and the `wg show` output; we can push the "onboarded-device" tag so split‑tunnel routes are installed.

jamie: welcome @sam :tada: — if you want I can DM the quick checklist I used on my first week.

devops-bot: certificate rotation completed for bastion.corp.redwood.com at 2026-03-23T09:12:00Z — no expected downtime.

sam: tried `ssh -D 1080 -p 443` — socks proxy works, I can reach the dashboard and `git fetch` now. thanks! logged a ticket (INC-4721) for the device tag + route push.

marta: great — tagging the ticket and assigning to infra. long term we'll add automatic device tagging during Okta onboarding so split‑tunnel keeps internal prefixes. for now your workaround is fine. ping me if it reoccurs. :+1:

sam: thanks everyone — saved my first week! :)
